master_plan_principles_consumed.principle_text: AtomicRows is parameter inventory, not a trader or source of live authority.
Single-parameter or single-algorithm trade selection is forbidden; QTT uses role-complete parameter stacks.
Required stack roles include SIGNAL, SCORING, NORMALIZATION, RISK, EXECUTION, CAPITAL, LATENCY, ERROR_GUARD, and repo-required QUANTUM_ADVISORY.
Blocked, source-missing, negative, unknown, owner-pending, rejected, or dormant rows are excluded from active selected stacks and may appear only as blocked diagnostics.
Quantum optimizers may rank or refine candidate stack ordering but cannot become direct live order authority.
Classical execution gates remain final for execution release, and the live decision chain reaches execution routing only after upstream gates.
Execution Router remains the final order-submission authority; this static selection gate creates no order authority.
Candidate stacks must proceed through separate replay/paper and owner review gates before live promotion claims.

Do not invent parameter values, ranges, defaults, source claims, optimizer defaults, broker settings, venue rules, financial constants, quantum backend values, owner assignments, code paths, runtime receipts, test pass claims, AtomicRows bundle creation, or zip ingestion success.
